# PDFMonkey

PDFMonkey is a service that automates the generation of PDF documents from templates, allowing users to create professional PDFs programmatically.

Category: Productivity. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/pdfmonkey/.

## Actions

- **Create Document**: Create a Document.
- **Create Document Sync**: Create a document and wait for generation to finish.
- **Create Template**: Create a new Document Template.
- **Delete Document**: Delete a Document by its ID.
- **Delete PDFMonkey Document Template**: Delete a document template by ID.
- **Download Document File** (read-only): Download a generated PDF file via a presigned URL.
- **Get Current User** (read-only): Retrieve details about the currently authenticated user.
- **Get Document** (read-only): Fetch a Document by its ID.
- **Get DocumentCard** (read-only): Fetch a DocumentCard by ID.
- **Get Template by ID** (read-only): Fetch a Document Template by ID.
- **List DocumentCards** (read-only): List DocumentCards.
- **List Template Cards** (read-only): List template cards for a workspace.
- **List Workspaces** (read-only): List workspaces (applications).
- **Preview Document** (read-only): Open a document preview via a PDF.js viewer.
- **Preview Template** (read-only): Preview a template draft as a real PDF via the preview_url.
- **Update Document**: Update a Document’s payload, meta, or status.
- **Update Document Template**: Update a document template’s properties.
- **List PDF Engines** (read-only): List available PDF engines with deprecation metadata.
- **View Public Share Link** (read-only): Download a publicly shared PDF via its permanent share link.
